en:
Me n' Kojima, the TenCozy tag team,
are gonna dice y'all into tiny little pieces.

I don't care if I have to fight one or both of you.
Let's just hurry up and get it over with.

Don't ya remember? For us, one plus one
ain't two. It's two hundred.

I remember. One plus one is two hundred.
Ten times more than normal, right?
Glad ya understand.

We're gonna be puttin' all our effort into
this fight, so ya better return the favor.

This JUSTIS bullshit ain't really our
cup of tea, if I'm bein' honest.

If we get good fights outta it,
that's all that matters.

Ya guys better make it interesting.
If this's just another borin' slog...
...We'll slaughter every last one of ya.

So the TenCozy tag team is up next.
They won't be an easy opponent.

Let's make sure we're ready
before we fight them.

So we're finally going up
against Tenzan and Kojima.

Yeah. They're both strong on their own,
but their power multiplies when they're together.

It's not gonna be as smooth as the other
Lunatics. We need to be ready.

Make sure you keep a careful eye on
their movements, Kiryu-san.

Kamurocho is JUSTIS's home base, remember.
Things'll be way rougher than in Onomichi.

But if we can manage to win, that should really
shake some things up in their organization.

Once we win here, JUSTIS is gonna be totally
on the ropes. Let's give this all we got!
Got it!

Glad to see ya here, Joe. I was thinkin'
you'd run with your tail between your legs.
I'm not afraid of an idiot like you.

We're gonna beat you, then take down Okada,
and destroy JUSTIS while we're at it!

Ya sure you can do that? You've never won
a single fight against Okada, y'know.

Not yet I haven't.
Things have changed, though.

Look at that.
You grew into a real bold little shit.

Fine. Show us how strong ya are now.
If ya want Okada, you gotta go through us!

We've beaten every last one of your men.
Now just surrender, nice and easy.

Surrender?
The hell're you sayin'?

Group battles ain't our bag. We're not too big
on commandin' other people, y'know.

We prefer talkin' with our fists.
That's the best way to settle shit.
What he's sayin' is... we're just gettin' started.

We only got two of us left at this point,
but us two're all we need.
That's how the TenCozy tag team rolls!

Not bad. You know,
I actually don't mind you guys.

I have to agree. I'd much rather settle
things in a man-to-man fight, too.

Perfect. How 'bout it, then?
You guys wanna throw down?

You n' Joe versus me n' Tenzan.
It'll be a four man deathmatch.

Sounds good to me.
How about you, Joe?

You don't even have to ask.
If they wanna fight, I'll fight.
Hell yeah! Let's do it, Koji!
Uh-huh! Ya better be ready for us!

You're strong...
Joe, too. You've gotten real good.
I didn't think I'd ever hear that from you.

Man, ya bastards brought down the TenCozy tag team...
Nobody's done that since Okada took us on.

Before you guys joined JUSTIS, you were
in the color gangs, weren't you?

Yeah. Your friend Joe here and Okada
hated the color gangs with a burnin' passion.

That's why they made JUSTIS, y'know.
They wanted to crush the color gangs.
We weren't expectin' to lose, though.
And once you lost to them, you disbanded.

Went extinct's more like it.
They pounded us into the goddamn ground.

But y'know, we can't help followin' someone
who's stronger than us. It's our policy.

Right. We lost to Okada, so we ditched our colors
and moved over to JUSTIS. That's the short of it.

Which brings us to today,
n' our loss to the Kiryu Clan.

Yup, guess we don't got much choice.
We'll be followin' our policy n' joinin' you guys.

We just told ya we follow whoever's stronger than us!
Ya guys won, so we're on your side now.

You're not allowed to say no. This's our policy,
so we've gotta do it no matter what.

Plus now that we lost to ya,
we're totally gettin' kicked outta JUSTIS.
What do you think...?

It should be fine.
There's a weird sort of logic to it.
Reminds me of myself in a way.
Glad ya get us, Kiryu-san.

Let's kick some ass, yeah?
N' don't worry, we won't hold ya back.
Who is that?

Another Lunatic, Tanahashi. He was a good friend.
One of the only ones who ever understood me.
Huh, is that so?

Honestly, I'd rather not fight him if I can help it...
But we don't have much choice here.

Man, there's nothing harder than
having to fight your friends.

Maybe so. But sometimes it's easier
to let your fists express how you feel.

I hope that's the case for you and Okada.
It would be nice if you two made up.
Your men are strong, Kiryu Clan.

Color me impressed, Joe. You've grown
quite a bit since leaving the JUSTIS ranks.
I don't care about that.

Tana. Don't you realize? JUSTIS is no different
from the shitty color gangs back in the day.
...I know.

Then why are you throwing your weight behind
Okada? We need to show him this is wrong!

You're right.
He may well be out of line.

Even so, I promised I would follow him...
and I intend to keep that promise.
But why!?

Answer me this. Have you ever considered
how it is he grew to be this way?
It may seem evil from your point of view.

But to him,
it's his own personal brand of justice.
And I agree with it.

Anyway, I think that's enough for now.
We can end here for today.

Remember, we're enemies.
Our next meeting will be in battle.
Hold on, Tana!

I need to know. What changed
Okada into the man he is now?

Didn't we crush the color gangs?
Why does he need more power than that?
And also... Why do you stand by him?

If you want to know... You'll have to defeat me.
Goodbye.

Goddammit.
How did things turn out like this?
It's time for the next Lunatic, Tanahashi.
Yeah... But I'm not really feeling it.

Tana was my friend. And he's
every bit as strong as Okada.
This is gonna be a struggle, then.

Tanahashi... He looked like he was
an incredibly reserved man.
You know, he didn't use to be so serious.

He used to play a real mean air guitar, or would shout
"I love you!" for no reason. Pretty weird, huh?
That's a bit of an understatement.

He really is a great person deep down, though.
He's never been as restrained as he is now.
When exactly did he start changing?

Probably around the same time as Okada. Something
must have happened between the two of them.

Hey, if we beat this Tanahashi guy, he's gonna
tell us everything that happened, right?
Yeah. We can't afford to lose.

Hearing what he has to say will be the first step
toward learning the truth about Okada.

All right! We gotta make sure
we give this our all, then!
Damn right.

I never thought the day would come
that we'd have to fight, Tana.

Same goes for me, Joe.
We... used to be so close.

Don't forget your promise. If we beat you here,
you'll tell us whatever we want to know.

Yeah, a deal is a deal.
I'm warning you, though. It won't be easy.

I'm going to devote every ounce
of my strength to winning here today.

Even against you...
I don't plan on holding back.

Don't give me that. You've never really been
one for self-restraint in the past.

I guess you're right, Joe.
You know me well.

I love that side of you.
Honestly, Joe.

Now then, the time for talking is over. Let's begin.
I'm going to show you the strength of the Six Lunatics!
You're pretty tough, Joe.

Same to you, Tana.
We've got you cornered, though.

Not yet you don't.
I was just giving you a little handicap.

Let's settle this one-on-one.
See who comes out on top.
Tanahashi!

How pathetic, being defeated by these fools.
It seems we'll have to clean up your mess for you.
Now then... Beat these two to death!

You can't just butt in when we're about
to settle things. This isn't your fight.

There are tons of them...
Kiryu-san, you gonna be okay?
Absolutely. What about you?
Good. Watch my back, okay?
Yeah. I won't let you down!

You've done well to reach this point.
However, it's just about time to wrap up this party.
Move out! Slice these two to pieces!
Guess I lose, Joe.
You really are strong though, Tana.
What useless garbage.

You promised. Tell me everything
you know about Okada.

Right. Honestly, I wanted to
find a way to talk about this sooner.
That's my cue to leave.

This should stay between friends. I'm sure you
two have a lot to catch up on. Take your time.
I'll be waiting back at the hideout.

Welcome back, Joe.
Did Tanahashi fill you in?
Yeah. He told me everything.
Well? Let's hear it.
Hm, where should I start?

I told you how the reason we made JUSTIS to begin
with was to take down the color gangs, right?

At the start, JUSTIS was a tiny organization.
We quickly gained followers, though.

People all over the city were upset
with the color gangs reign of terror.

Thanks to Okada's charisma, we had
a pretty constant stream of new members.

We were lacking in numbers,
but had a wealth of team unity.

And once we grew big enough...
we finally took the color gangs out.
Things were still going well at that point, then.

But soon after, Okada changed and turned
JUSTIS into the gang it is today.

And the reason for that?
Did he give you one?

We destroyed the color gangs, but I guess the
guys pulling the strings were none too happy.
The ones pulling the strings?

Yakuza and mafia guys, no doubt. The gangs were
just proxies for them to commit their crimes.

And once the pawns were removed...
They were probably furious, I'd guess.
So they wanted retaliation for what you did...

Yeah. And the one they went after...
was Okada.

Yeah. They got hold of Okada soon after.
Put him through some horrible torture.

It wasn't just him, though. They apparently
even scarred up his girlfriend real bad.
That's horrible.

And after all that happened,
Okada didn't tell any of you about it?

Yeah. If we knew how bad it was, we would
have definitely tried to fight back.

But if we had, more and more people
would've been tortured just like Okada was.
I think that's why he stayed quiet.

Tanahashi figured it all out, though. Accidentally
walked in on Okada crying about his girlfriend.

Once he witnessed that, he felt like
he had to stand by Okada no matter what.
So that's how it happened...

That's right. I'd known him for years at that point,
but I'd never seen him look so somber before.
That day... That's when Okada changed.

He formed JUSTIS to protect what was important
to him, but he couldn't even keep his girlfriend safe...

Okada took the blame for that personally.
He thought JUSTIS wasn't strong enough.

Strength became his only goal. So, he brought in
anyone he deemed strong, even if they were evil.

The brawny Tenzan and Kojima. The secretive Naito.
Komei for military, and Yano for fundraising.
But that ruined him.
His team no longer stood for justice...

And all I've done is talk about his wrongdoing,
but I didn't know the heavy burden he shouldered.
I'm a failure of a friend.

So what are you going to do?
Do you want to stop going after JUSTIS?
No. I won't stop.

I... I think I know how Okada felt.
He must have been sad. Depressed, even.

Even so, what Okada's been doing now is no better
than the torture those guys inflicted on him.

He gained power to protect the people around him,
but he's hurting others at the same time.

He's brought forth a second and third
terrible version of himself.

He's strong, though. And charismatic.
Not only was he a friend, but a role model, too.
That's why... I need to get him back.

It's my job as a friend.
I need to correct his wrongdoing.
Joe... You've really grown.

Joe. Being friends with someone is more
than just fun and games all the time.

If they do something wrong, you get mad at them.
If they lose control, you do what it takes to stop them.

Most importantly, you have to be willing to drop
everything for them. That's what a true friend does.

We've gotten all different types in the
Kiryu Clan, but only you can stop him.

Don't forget that. And...
Make sure your emotions get through to him.

Make sure you're ready for
whatever happens, Joe. Understood?

Joe. Kiryu-san.
Please let me help you.

As I was listening to the two
of you talk, I realized something.

Even though I thought I was supporting Okada...
I think I was cornering him the whole time.

A true pal would stop his friend from doing
something wrong. That's clear to me now.

And... Okada's definitely one of my friends.
Let's bring him down together.
Tana... Thank you.

Huh, I think some of my energy's coming back.
It's almost like my old self's gonna pop right out of me.
